# Calvary Chapel Frederick

> A Calvary Chapel church in downtown Frederick, Maryland. Verse-by-verse Bible teaching. Pastor David Ochoa.

Calvary Chapel Frederick meets at 244A S Jefferson St, Frederick, MD 21701.

Service times (America/New_York):
- Sunday 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM
- Wednesday 7:00 PM Bible study
- Midday prayer Monday, Wednesday, and Friday 12:15–12:45 PM

Latest published message (as of 14 Aug 2026): Acts 21:18–25, Pastor David Ochoa.

Children’s ministry:
- Sunday: infants through 5th grade
- Wednesday children’s church: ages 3–11
- Middle school Sunday 9:00 AM; high school attends the main service
- Midweek youth: Ignite (middle and high school)

The church does not pass an offering plate. Giving is via sanctuary boxes or online.

Official site: https://www.calvaryfrederick.com
Phone: +1-301-663-4485
Email: info@calvaryfrederick.com

- [Home](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/): Overview, times, ministries, latest teaching
- [Plan a Visit](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/visit/): What to expect, kids, beliefs, visit form
- [Ministries](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/): Preschool, children, students, young adults, women, men, small groups, volunteer
- [Preschool](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/preschool/): Youngest children in Sunday children’s ministry
- [Children](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/children/): Sunday infants–5th; Wednesday children’s church ages 3–11
- [Students](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/students/): Middle school Sunday 9:00; Ignite midweek; youth@calvaryfrederick.com
- [Young Adults](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/young-adults/): Growing in the Word in this season
- [Women](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/women/): women@calvaryfrederick.com
- [Men](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/men/): 2nd and 4th Thursday inductive study in Mark; men@calvaryfrederick.com
- [Small Groups](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/small-groups/): Grow in faith and community through the week
- [Volunteer](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/ministries/volunteer/): Greeting, kids, A/V, coffee
- [Media](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/media/): Teachings and series (Subsplash). Latest: Acts 21:18–25, Aug 14, 2026
- [Watch](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/watch/): Redirects to Media
- [Give](https://www.calvaryfrederick.com/give/): Offering boxes and online giving
